main_idea: On-policy distillation improves professional-work performance across two model families.
ideas: Nemotron distillation improves GDPval rubric scores and win-loss margin.
Qwen distillation achieves a similar, slightly larger margin.
Nemotron beats its base model across 220 GDPval tasks.
